description:
Return a domain's off-page authority from DataForSEO's backlink index: domain rank, total backlinks, referring domains, dofollow referring domains, spam score and broken backlinks. A major driver of why competitors out-rank and out-cite a site. Without `domain` it checks the site (cached on it for 24 h); pass `domain` to check a competitor instead.

Billing: free. Up to 50 new `domain` lookups a day per workspace (repeats within 24 h don't count).

Inputs: site_id — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites). domain — optional other domain to check (cached 24 h).

Output: { site_id, target, rank (0–1000, DataForSEO domain rank; higher = stronger), backlinks, referring_domains, dofollow_referring_domains, spam_score (0–100, DataForSEO's backlink spam score; higher = more links from spammy sites), broken_backlinks }, or { found: false } when the index has no data for the domain. Errors: provider_unavailable (the lookup failed; retry), rate_limited.

domain.description: Optional domain to check instead of the site (e.g. a competitor). Cached 24h.

site_id.description: Site to resolve (and cache the snapshot on); site_id from list_sites.

name: get_backlink_summary
title: Get a domain's off-page authority (backlink summary)
